headline: Nothing to do before kickoff — Caleb Williams stays locked with a hamstring until Tuesday morning, then move him to IR and start Geno Smith.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and week 2 is basically already played; only Monday night's Nabers game is left, and he's off the injury report and correctly starting. The lone open task is Tuesday's IR swap for Caleb Williams; the free-agent QB the checker flagged (Fernando Mendoza) turns out not to be a real pickup — Kirk Cousins is still the Raiders' starter.

ir.why: Out with a hamstring, carted off Sun Sep 20 vs MIN; MRI was today (Mon Sep 21) with no grade announced yet, and he's locked in the Superflex slot until the week's games complete Tuesday morning, so the IR move (and starting Geno Smith in his place) can only happen then.
